description: Investigate. Widening leaves ground scalars (int, float, atom, literals) unchanged under every mask: convergence_collapse is per-slot and convergence_class_at / convergence_class / erase_closure_identity are identity on them (reader F7-Q4, xxd10/f7_readers.md). So a key whose row is only scalars is the precise arrow whatever Recursive/InputDemand say, and call-site keying need not wait on them (e.g. keying Kernel.+/2 with (int, int)). Open: tuples of scalars (e.g. {int, boolean}); transport still reads CallGraphComponent per executable; whether any job count actually drops once fz-xxd.10's scope facts land. Paper-first before a design.
title: A scalar row needs no keying facts
